intro.text: Welcome to Hello Museum. I am your guide. Follow me, and hold the mic button any time to ask me a question.

bridge.text: We begin in the logic wing, with an idea on paper.
Now we cross into the hardware wing, where ideas became machines.
Next, the software wing, where people learned to write for machines.
On to the interaction wing, and a famous demonstration.
Now we jump forward in time, to the network wing.
Our last stop is the AI wing, in the present day.

outro.text: That is the end of our tour. Every room has more to explore, so take your time.

fallback.text: Sorry, I could not answer that one. Let's keep walking.
